card.title: Certified Correct
card.instruction: Treat forms, standards, and exact wording as a technical craft. Correct shortcuts before discussing whether the result actually works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This cake cannot pass inspection. You've written 'Birthday Happy.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran out of room. Does it taste all right?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Taste is in section four. We need a correctly worded chocolate plaque over this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The plaque will hide all the candles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then relocate them, keeping the count intact. We mustn't correct the greeting by falsifying your mother's age.

mechanism: A handles birthday wording and candle number as exact inspection requirements that must be corrected before taste can be considered.
confusable: Unlike generic pedantry, each correction must be a concrete craft operation whose formal accuracy takes priority over whether the cake works.
comparison: This alternative solves one formal defect without introducing another; the arrow alternative refuses to judge a result until the reference standard is restored.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
